name: System font stack only, no web fonts
definition: Is all text set in a generic system font stack (system-ui, Helvetica Neue/Arial) with no custom web fonts loaded?

name: Generous body line height
definition: Is body text sized about 16-17px with a roomy line height (about 1.5-1.7)?

name: Small uppercase eyebrow above headings
definition: Do small letter-spaced (uppercase or script) eyebrow labels sit above section headings?

name: Bold-weight headings
definition: Are section headings and titles set in bold weight (about 700)?

name: Sentence/title case, no uppercase transform
definition: Do headings, nav and labels use sentence or title case instead of all caps?

name: Very large hero headline
definition: Is the hero h1 very large (e.g. about 60px or more, or filling much of the hero width)?

name: Small uppercase letter-spaced utility labels
definition: Are minor labels (form labels, footer headings, dates, sidebar labels, CTAs) set in small uppercase with letter spacing?

name: Large lead paragraph styling
definition: Is there a distinct larger lead/body paragraph styled differently from the rest of the copy?

name: Serif body with sans headings pairing
definition: Does the page pair a sans-serif for headings/UI with a serif face for body paragraphs or excerpts?

name: Serif headings with sans body
definition: Are headings set in a serif face while body text is sans-serif?

name: Single sans-serif family throughout
definition: Is one single sans-serif family used consistently across the whole page?

name: Uppercase section headings
definition: Are main headings or card titles set in uppercase?

name: Large bold heading scale vs body
definition: Are headings large and bold with a dramatic size jump over body text?

name: Two-tone hero headline
definition: Does the hero headline use two tones, with part of it in an accent color?

name: Condensed heavy display headline font
definition: Are headlines set in a heavy condensed display face such as Impact?

name: Bold labels with regular values
definition: Do contact lines bold only the labels while values stay regular weight?

name: Hero h1 with accent rule and italic subtitle
definition: Is the hero h1 accompanied by an accent rule and an italic serif subtitle?

name: Hero subtitle as plain paragraph
definition: Is the hero subtitle a plain sentence-case sans paragraph rather than a heading?

name: Light restrained heading scale
definition: Are section headings moderate in size and light in weight?

name: Single serif family throughout
definition: Is all text set in one serif family such as Georgia?

name: Near-black or tinted dark body text
definition: Is the body text a dark tinted (navy, slate, green) or near-black color rather than neutral gray or pure black?

name: Single accent color
definition: Is one single accent color used consistently across buttons, links and labels?

name: Alternating full-width background bands
definition: Do sections alternate between differently colored full-width background bands (white, pale, dark)?

name: Restrained multi-hue palette
definition: Is the overall palette a small, specific set of named hues (e.g. green/gold, teal, navy/amber) rather than generic colors?

name: Dark theme with light text
definition: Does the page use a dark near-black body background with light/near-white text?

name: Muted secondary text color
definition: Is secondary text (dates, subtitles, labels) shown in a muted gray or taupe tone?

name: Green deep link text
definition: Are links deep green text without chevron markers?

name: Hero diagonal gradient background
definition: Does the hero use a diagonal gradient background instead of flat color?

name: Light header with thin border
definition: Is the header white or light with a thin bottom border and dark text navigation?

name: Light uppercase links without underline
definition: Are links light or white uppercase text without underline, except inline card links?

name: Score-coded metric colors
definition: Are metric values color-coded by score level at uniform size?

name: Solid black announcement bar
definition: Is the announcement bar solid black with bold white text?

name: Warm cream or off-white page background
definition: Is the page background a warm cream or off-white tint rather than pure white?

name: Multi-column dark footer
definition: Is the footer a dark band with multiple columns of links and a divider above small copyright text?

name: Centered narrow max-width container
definition: Is the main content constrained to a centered, fixed or max-width container with generous side margins (narrower than full viewport)?

name: Simple logo-left nav-right header
definition: Is the header a single compact bar with a logo on the left and navigation links on the right?

name: Equal card grid
definition: Are items shown as a grid or row of equal-size cards (bordered or panelled) in multiple columns?

name: Uses CSS grid with flexbox
definition: Is the page layout built with CSS grid and/or flexbox containers?

name: Split hero or section with image and text
definition: Does a hero or section use a two-column split pairing an image with a text panel or text column?

name: Full-bleed hero image with overlaid text
definition: Is the hero a full-width edge-to-edge image (often darkened) with headline text overlaid on it?

name: Compact short page with tight spacing
definition: Is the page compact and short with tight vertical rhythm and no large empty gaps?

name: Single-column stacked full-width sections
definition: Is the page a single column of full-width stacked sections or alternating colored bands without a sidebar?

name: Left-aligned editorial or section heading layout
definition: Are section headings left-aligned on plain backgrounds, or editorial text in a narrow left-aligned column?

name: Feature sections use full-bleed background images with a dar
definition: Feature sections use full-bleed background images with a dark overlay and text overlaid on the left.

name: Hero shows several banners side by side as a cropped multi-p
definition: Hero shows several banners side by side as a cropped multi-panel strip rather than a slider.

name: Hero with CTA at far right
definition: Does the hero place its call-to-action or secondary element at the far right with empty space between?

name: Main content with sidebar
definition: Is there a wide main column with a narrow sidebar beside it?

name: Search form band below hero
definition: Is there a distinct search form band attached to the bottom of the hero?

name: Bordered rounded content cards
definition: Are content items shown as bordered or rounded white cards in a grid?

name: Fully rounded pill buttons
definition: Are the primary buttons or calls to action fully rounded pills?

name: Horizontal text navigation
definition: Is navigation a visible horizontal row of text links?

name: Inline newsletter signup
definition: Is the newsletter signup an email input inline with a submit button?

name: Pill chips and tags
definition: Are tags, filters, or suggested links shown as small rounded pill chips?

name: Social links as text labels
definition: Are social links plain text labels (possibly pills) rather than icon glyphs?

name: Full-width promo or CTA band
definition: Is there a full-width solid or dark promotional band with a headline and CTA?

name: Plain text logo wordmark
definition: Is the logo a text wordmark with a small accent rather than an image?

name: Secondary CTAs as text links
definition: Are secondary or read-more actions styled as text links rather than boxed buttons?

name: Square or small-radius buttons
definition: Do buttons have square corners or only a small corner radius rather than pill shapes?

name: Text-only cards with accent edge
definition: Are cards text-only with a colored left or top accent border?

name: Dark footer
definition: Is the footer a dark band?

name: Light footer with simple links
definition: Is the footer light with plain link columns or rows?

name: Miscellaneous content blocks
definition: Does the page include a distinct content block such as a calendar, feed, share links, or sign-up block?

name: Search field joined with button
definition: Is search an input joined to a labeled button, or absent from the header?

name: Solid filled brand-color CTA buttons
definition: Are the main call-to-action buttons solid filled with a brand color and rounded or plain corners?

name: Top announcement strip
definition: Is there a thin announcement strip at the top of the page?

name: Underlined inline links
definition: Are inline body links underlined?

name: Dark utility bar above header
definition: Is there a slim dark utility bar above the main header?

name: Small badges and labels
definition: Are categories, dates, or status shown as small badge or label boxes?

name: Circular pagination controls
definition: Does pagination or carousel navigation use circular dots or rounded boxes?

name: Circular social icons
definition: Are social links shown as small circular icon or letter badges?

name: Logo strips and sponsor grids
definition: Are logos displayed in white tiles, strips, or grids?

name: Plain link lists
definition: Are link lists plain single-column stacks of bold links?

name: Profile and avatar elements
definition: Are people shown as profile cards, avatars, or testimonial photos?

name: Section header with view-all link
definition: Do section headers pair a heading with a right-aligned view-all link?

name: Simple form layout
definition: Do forms use simple narrow or full-width native controls?

name: Medium corner radius scale
definition: Do cards and buttons consistently use 8-15px radii?

name: Menu toggle button
definition: Is there a rounded text menu toggle button?

name: Primary plus outlined secondary buttons
definition: Does a primary solid button appear alongside an outlined secondary button?

name: Segmented toggle control
definition: Is there a segmented toggle for binary or purchase choices?

name: Statistics display
definition: Are statistics shown as numbers in tiles or inline?

name: Text overlaid on imagery
definition: Is text overlaid on images or thumbnails?

name: Bold links without underline
definition: Are links bold and not underlined?

name: Heading with accent underline rule
definition: Do section headings have a short accent underline rule?

name: Flat look without shadows or gradients
definition: Does the page look flat, with no or almost no box shadows, gradients, or backdrop blur?

name: Large or medium rounded corners widely used
definition: Are medium-to-large corner radii (about 8px or more) used widely across cards, buttons and images?

name: Gradient hero background
definition: Does the hero section use a CSS gradient background rather than a photo?

name: Rounded cards with soft shadows
definition: Do cards or panels combine rounded corners with soft drop shadows for depth?

name: Hover transitions on interactive elements
definition: Do interactive elements define CSS transitions?

name: Small or square corner radii
definition: Are corners square or only slightly rounded, with no large radii?

name: Colored left-border accent on cards
definition: Do cards carry a thick accent-colored left border?

name: Restrained visual effects overall
definition: Are visual effects (shadows, transitions, transforms) minimal across the page?

name: Short accent underline under headings
definition: Do section headings have a short colored accent underline bar?

name: White bordered cards on off-white background
definition: Do content cards and plates sit as white, bordered, rounded boxes on an off-white or tinted page background?

name: Decorative marker on card headings
definition: Are card headings marked with a small green square or decorative icon image?

name: Decorative star-glyph italic label strip
definition: Is there a strip of italic serif labels with decorative star bullets below the hero?

name: Diagonal wedge section divider
definition: Does the hero end with a full-width diagonal wedge divider?

name: Footer disclaimer below thin divider
definition: Do legal disclaimer and copyright sit below a thin divider in small light text?

name: Hero background is a soft peach-to-cream gradient.
definition: Hero background is a soft peach-to-cream gradient.

name: No brush-stroke section dividers
definition: Are section edges free of brush-stroke or torn-paint dividers?

name: Offset lip edges and tilted elements
definition: Do cards and photos use solid offset edges and tilted shadowed elements instead of soft effects?

name: Plain text rows with divider rules
definition: Are lists plain text rows separated by thin divider rules without icons?

name: Sections separated by tone and rules
definition: Are sections separated by alternating dark tones and thin horizontal rules?

name: Soft large-blur image shadows
definition: Do feature images carry soft, large-blur drop shadows?

name: Sticky header with backdrop blur
definition: Does the header use a semi-transparent background with backdrop blur?

name: Descriptive alt text, empty on decorative
definition: Do meaningful images have descriptive alt text while decorative icons have empty alt?

name: Images with rounded corners and shadow
definition: Do images have rounded corners and/or drop shadows, including arch or curved crops?

name: Colored tiles replace photography
definition: Are photos replaced by solid-color, pastel or gradient block tiles with text or icons?

name: Text-only cards without imagery
definition: Are cards or product items text-only with no images, or sparse imagery overall?

name: Hero image darkening overlay
definition: Does the hero photo have a darkening overlay or gradient behind the heading text?

name: Icons are inline SVG
definition: Are icons inline SVG elements rather than icon fonts?

name: Images cropped to uniform small sizes
definition: Are images or thumbnails cropped via object-fit to uniform small sizes, sometimes cutting off subjects?

name: Placeholder image reused across cards
definition: Is one placeholder image repeated across gallery, product or card items?

name: Small left-aligned logo or sponsor strip
definition: Are sponsor or partner logos small, uniformly sized and left-aligned in a strip?

name: All images load without breakage
definition: Do all images load with valid sizes, with no broken images or icon-font glyph failures?

name: Distorted scaled-down images
definition: Are small images scaled so their aspect ratio is distorted?

name: Full-bleed hero photograph
definition: Is there a large full-bleed hero or team photograph as an img element?

name: Grey no-preview placeholder
definition: Do missing images show a grey 'No preview available' placeholder rather than a broken image?

name: Header logo legible size
definition: Is the logo displayed at a clearly legible size in the header?

name: Hero photos lack tint overlay
definition: Do hero photos appear in near-natural color without a flat duotone or tint overlay?

name: Icons absent, text labels used
definition: Are utility actions shown as plain text labels with no SVG icons?

name: Icons uniform small squares in cards
definition: Are icons normalized to a uniform small square size inside cards?

name: Media embeds replaced by link cards
definition: Are video or media embeds replaced with text-link cards?

name: Slogan graphic in shadowed card
definition: Is a standalone slogan graphic shown small inside a white shadowed card?

name: Small circular avatar
definition: Is there a small circular avatar next to a name and subtitle?

name: Title: brand plus tagline (dash)
definition: Does the page title combine the brand name with a descriptive tagline joined by a dash (em or en)?

name: Arrow-ended call-to-action links
definition: Do links or calls-to-action end with an arrow glyph such as →?

name: Sentence/title case instead of all caps
definition: Do buttons, headings, nav and link labels use sentence or title case rather than all-caps uppercase?

name: Title: short brand-only name
definition: Is the page title a short plain brand name without keyword lists or trailing separators?

name: Calm copy without emoji or exclamations
definition: Is the copy restrained, with few exclamation marks and no emoji?

name: Title: brand plus tagline (pipe)
definition: Does the page title combine the brand name with a tagline or slogan joined by a pipe separator?

name: Typographic glyphs and polished copy
definition: Does the copy use typographic glyphs like ® or ↑ inline and read as polished and error-free?

name: Added section headings for unlabeled blocks
definition: Are headings added to previously unlabeled blocks, such as a blog heading?

name: Centered-dot meta separator
definition: Do meta lines separate author and date with a centered dot?

name: Descriptive alt text
definition: Do images have descriptive alt text matching their content, such as 'Screenshot of' prefixes?

name: Excerpts only on lead cards
definition: Do excerpts appear only on hero and lead-row cards while later cards show just title and meta?

name: Header site name on dark band
definition: Does the header show the site name in light text on a dark band with an italic tagline?

name: Hero benefit bullets with check icons
definition: Does the hero include benefit bullets with circular check icons?

name: Hero halves with logo and caption
definition: Are hero halves labeled with a logo and a short uppercase caption?

name: Instructive input placeholder example
definition: Does an input placeholder give an instructive example format such as 'e.g. example.com'?

name: Italic serif empty-state placeholder
definition: Do empty states use an italic serif placeholder line?

name: Minimal card metadata
definition: Do cards show only minimal metadata with no timestamps or reply chips?

name: Section-ending CTA buttons
definition: Do sections end with explicit call-to-action buttons beneath short intro paragraphs?

name: Short concise nav labels
definition: Are nav labels and titles short and concise?

name: Title: brand followed by services list
definition: Does the page title lead with the brand name followed by a list of products or services?

name: Title: descriptive sentence of offering
definition: Is the page title a descriptive sentence stating what the site offers and for whom?

name: Truncated card titles with ellipsis
definition: Are long card titles truncated with an ellipsis?

name: Uppercase promo headline with offer label
definition: Is the promo headline a full uppercase sentence in large display type with the offer as a small label above?

name: Semantic landmark elements used
definition: Does the page use HTML5 semantic landmark/sectioning elements (header, main, nav, section, article, footer, aside) rather than generic divs?

name: Lean minimal DOM and styling
definition: Is the markup lean, with few divs, classes, scripts, external stylesheets and inline styles?

name: Clean hierarchical heading outline
definition: Does the page have a clean, properly nested heading hierarchy (e.g. h1, then h2 sections, then h3 items) without skipped levels?

name: Descriptive alt text on images
definition: Do all images carry descriptive, non-empty alt text?

name: ARIA attributes and real buttons
definition: Does the page use ARIA attributes and real button elements for interactive controls?

name: Decorative images with empty alt
definition: Do most images use empty alt attributes for decorative purposes?

name: Irregular or missing h1 heading
definition: Is the heading outline irregular, such as lacking an h1 or starting at h3 or skipping levels?

name: Language attribute declared
definition: Does the html element declare a lang attribute?

name: Cards wrapped in article elements
definition: Are repeated posts or cards wrapped in article elements?

name: Figure and blockquote for quotes
definition: Are quotes marked up with figure, blockquote and figcaption elements?

name: Minimal head meta tags
definition: Does the head contain only a few basic meta tags (charset, viewport, description)?

name: Plain short document title
definition: Is the document title short and plain, without keyword stuffing or decoration?

name: Strikethrough prices use s tag
definition: Are struck-through prices marked with the s element?

name: Address element for contact details
definition: Are contact details wrapped in an address element?

name: Class names are semantic rather than utility-style.
definition: Class names are semantic rather than utility-style.

name: Details/summary disclosure widget
definition: Does the page use a native details/summary disclosure?

name: Item titles use h3 headings
definition: Are card or item titles marked up as h3 headings under h2 sections?

name: Navigation marked up as lists
definition: Are navigation and link groups marked up as ul/li lists?

name: Lean self-contained markup, no scripts
definition: Is the page markup lean and self-contained, with few elements, no or minimal scripts, and little or no inline styling?

name: Few CSS transitions, no animations
definition: Does the page define few or no CSS transitions and no CSS animations (minimal interactivity)?

name: Frequent CSS grid layout use
definition: Does the page use CSS grid for layout relatively often alongside flexbox?

name: Many hover transitions
definition: Do interactive elements use many CSS transitions for hover polish?

name: Single embedded style, no effects
definition: Is styling a single embedded style block with no inline styles, shadows, animations or transforms?

name: Small hand-written class set
definition: Is styling done with a small hand-written set of classes rather than utility or framework classes?
